language.title: Language
language.label: Application language
language.hint: Applies immediately and is remembered the next time you open Ascua.
language.error: The language could not be changed.

voice.title: Voice
voice.hint: Talk to Ascua and hear it answer. Everything is processed on this computer: only the text reaches the assistant.
voice.sample: Hi, I'm Ascua. This is how I sound.
voice.prepareHint: Downloads the voice models (about 960 MB with a GPU, about 650 MB without one) so they are ready when you need them.
voice.credit: Voice: Supertonic 3 by Supertone (Open RAIL-M), downloaded from Hugging Face. Recognition: Whisper.
